subject: RM_Weepmat
departures: Dark green-black colouring, close to black, not bright moss-green
Regular parallel ridges like corduroy instead of a soft cushion or fuzzy tufts
Every ridge runs the same way, square to the sea-wind, so the mat looks combed or striated
A wet, glistening sheen along the weep-lines, like a damp streak
Lies flat against cold vertical stone faces, following the shape of the wet streak where the stone seeps
